title: First-person tools round 2: edge leads, combos, construct hammer
desc: First-person construct tools (sword, pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe, hammer) form from the ring and swing twice, with the working edge always leading the motion.

takes.name: Sword slash
takes.facts: edge-true slash (kept from 802); hit tick 4; forms over ticks 0-14, swing 8 ticks, played twice with a 6-tick rest

takes.name: Sword diagonal chop
takes.facts: upper right to lower left, cuts with the edge; hit tick 11; forms over ticks 0-14, swing 16 ticks, played twice with a 6-tick rest

takes.name: Sword sweep pair
takes.facts: two sweeps, edge true; hits ticks 5, 10; forms over ticks 0-14, swing 14 ticks, played twice with a 6-tick rest

takes.name: Sword thrust
takes.facts: drawn back 0.24 m, then a straight stab 0.34 m, edge upright; hit tick 8; forms over ticks 0-14, swing 14 ticks, played twice with a 6-tick rest

takes.name: Sword combo: slash, backhand, chop
takes.facts: three hits at ticks 4, 9, 15; forms over ticks 0-14, swing 20 ticks, played twice with a 6-tick rest

takes.name: Sword combo: sweep, thrust
takes.facts: two hits at ticks 5, 13; forms over ticks 0-14, swing 17 ticks, played twice with a 6-tick rest

takes.name: Pickaxe
takes.facts: raised, point-first strike, bounce; hit tick 9; forms over ticks 0-14, swing 13 ticks, played twice with a 6-tick rest

takes.name: Axe
takes.facts: controlled diagonal chop, blade leading, short recoil; hit tick 9; forms over ticks 0-14, swing 14 ticks, played twice with a 6-tick rest

takes.name: Shovel
takes.facts: blade flat, driven in ahead, levered back, lifted and flicked; hit tick 6; forms over ticks 0-14, swing 15 ticks, played twice with a 6-tick rest

takes.name: Hoe
takes.facts: raised, blade hooked into the ground ahead, dragged back; hit tick 6; forms over ticks 0-14, swing 13 ticks, played twice with a 6-tick rest

takes.name: Hammer overhead
takes.facts: solid construct hammer, face-first; hit tick 13; forms over ticks 0-14, swing 19 ticks, played twice with a 6-tick rest

takes.name: Hammer from the side
takes.facts: construct hammer swung flat into a wall; hit tick 8; forms over ticks 0-14, swing 13 ticks, played twice with a 6-tick rest
